caption: The drawing is a black-and-white illustration showing a detailed garden layout, labeled "THE J.P. MARTIN GARDEN – THE BLACKWELL SURVEY" at the bottom. The composition includes an organized central garden section with geometric and winding paths dividing various planting beds of different shapes such as circles, ovals, and curves. In the upper section, there is a fenced area, possibly a field or lawn, surrounded by trees and shrubs. The bottom left section features a large fountain with a bird, possibly a heron, perched on rocks in the water, with stylized water jets rising upwards. Dense clusters of trees border the garden, with individual trees and groups scattered throughout the drawing. Near the bottom center-right, there is a rectangular area that appears to be a greenhouse or large structure with a grid pattern on the roof. The background and surrounding landscape are filled with different types of trees and shrubbery. The only colors used are black ink on a cream or light tan background; all objects, plants, and structures are depicted with line work and shading.
title: Isaac P. Martin Garden
